chain: Per-file no-follow regular-source inventory hashes and stable identity stamps.
Exact ordered tar member names/types/permissions/owners/mtime/sizes and all regular contents verified against inventory.
Local archive SHA equals full external readback SHA; external identity stable during readback.
All source manifest stamps rechecked before completion; final plan identity unchanged.
Only verified temporary local tar removed; original corpus retained.

remaining_concrete_checks: Compare all current source entry stamps and exact deletion directory membership against saved manifest immediately before reclamation; this review checked only root and two summaries.
Confirm current scoped active consumers/dependencies do not use these shard payloads. Original copy-time process observation had incomplete visibility and is not a present consumer proof.
Recheck external identity against this observation and retain original verified receipts/source manifest; no fresh 13GB hash is required solely by this review if archive identity remains stable.
retain_locally: Frozen checkpoint, training completion, run summary, realized schedule and arena receipts outside corpus.
reclamation.proposed_removal_scope: Only exact archived shard directories after the above checks; preserve top-level summaries at original paths.
reclamation.restoration: Training/row consumers require restoring full arrays, not summaries alone. Refresh identity-based qualification after restoration where inode/ctime is bound.
reclamation.space_note: Logical source bytes and tar bytes are not allocated-byte reclamation measurements; measure actual free/allocated delta only after an authorized successful removal.

limits: No new source payload or external tar payload hash, transfer, deletion, inference or repeated process fixture.
Saved source manifest streamed once independently; current complete source-tree stability has not been rechecked.
ACL/xattrs were captured by tar but not independently compared.
No measured physical reserve/staging peak is inferred from success; existing enforced guards and recorded process resources are distinguished.
projection_scope: Exact selected review fields; local evidence paths and external inode/stat tuple omitted. Original receipt remains externally hash-bound.
